_comment: mcp-research.json — research_agent profile. Extends core with Tier 2 web access + Tier 3 FAISS. Launch Firecrawl first: cd ~/workspace/firecrawl && docker compose up -d

firecrawl._comment: Firecrawl self-hosted (Docker, localhost:3002). Provides /v1/search (defaults to Google), /v1/scrape, /v1/crawl, /v1/map. WARNING: self-hosted lacks /agent, /browser, Fire-engine anti-bot. Use safari_mcp as fallback for bot-protected pages. Docker overhead ~2-4 GB RAM.

safari_mcp._comment: Safari MCP — 80 tools, native WebKit, ~60% less CPU than Chrome. Uses your real logged-in Safari session. Useful for login-gated pages (LinkedIn, etc.) and as search fallback when Firecrawl is rate-limited. MIT. SECURITY: disable 'Allow JavaScript from Apple Events' in Safari → Develop when not running agents.

faiss._comment: Local FAISS vector store for RAG. Embeddings via vllm-mlx --embedding-model. MIT.
